content: उच्छ्वासिन् {%a.%} .²1 Breathing, inhaling air. .²2 Heaving, throbbing; स्तनमध्योच्छ्वासिना कथितः <ls>V. 1. 8</ls>; <ls>Me. 104</ls>. .²3 Sighing. .²4 Expiring, dying. .²5 Vanishing, fading away; उच्छ्वासिकालाञ्जनरागमक्ष्णोः <ls>Ku. 7. 82</ls>. .²6 Pausing, stopping. .²7 Rising, coming forward. .²8 Disjointed, divided.
